note: Tuesday 07:02am SGT run. Latest completed US cash session = Monday 28 Sep close, a sharp risk-off day: S&P500 -0.77% to 7,683.69, Nasdaq -0.92%, Dow -0.67%, Russell2000 -0.69%, VIX +8.07% to 16.07 (still a low absolute level despite the jump). Unusually, gold (GLD -3.94%) and silver (SLV -5.49%, miners GDX -5.36%/SILJ -5.54%) fell WITH equities -- cross-asset deleveraging, not classic flight-to-quality -- while oil diverged (Brent -5.44%, WTI +0.98%). Fear & Greed's headline reading softened to 34/Fear from 37/Fear as CNN's own site again returned 403/451/418 errors on every direct/API attempt this run and had to be triangulated from mirrors (feargreedmeter.com's live pull showed 34, 'updated ~21 min ago', which is the most current single read located; aistockselection.com's component breakdown is still cached to 26 Sep and was not treated as fresh) -- component sub-scores below are therefore estimated from the real cross-asset moves (VIX up but still low, breadth deeply negative, gold/junk-bond signals) rather than pulled directly from CNN, and are flagged as such. Breadth had a materially worse, and better-sourced, session: thetrading.tools' Sep-28-dated snapshot puts %>50-day MA at 25.2% and %>200-day MA at 39.6% (both down from the prior run's ~28%/~45% approximations), McClellan Oscillator at -35 (16th percentile, down from -23), NYSE >2:1 decliners over advancers, NYSE 16 new highs vs 422 new lows and Nasdaq 50 vs 461, 8 of 11 S&P sectors closed red, and a separate recap cites Goldman Sachs noting the median S&P 500 stock now sits 16% below its 52-week high with the cumulative A-D line and %NYSE>200-day MA at their lowest since June 2025. Unlike the prior Friday up-day, Monday's breadth fell in sympathy with price rather than diverging from it, so 'Fear' sentiment and weak breadth are now confirming each other rather than conflicting. Flows: BofA's Flow Show publishes Fridays for the week ended the prior Wednesday: no new print has been issued since the week-ended-23-Sep report already on file (published 25 Sep) -- the next print (week ended 30 Sep) isn't due until Fri 2 Oct, so all regions/movements below are carried forward unchanged and explicitly still dated to that week; Monday's GLD/SLV selloff is real-time price action, not a flow print, and is noted separately rather than used to infer a dollar flow figure.

breadth.note: Breadth did not just stay narrow, it broke to fresh multi-month lows on Monday's risk-off session: %>50-day (25.2%) and %>200-day (39.6%) both fell further, the McClellan Oscillator dropped to -35, and the cumulative A-D line / %NYSE>200-day MA hit their weakest level since June 2025 -- crucially, decliners led advancers >2:1 and new lows swamped new highs, meaning breadth fell IN SYMPATHY with Monday's price decline rather than diverging from it as it had on Friday's up day. That alignment (price down, breadth down, Fear&Greed down) is a more internally consistent risk-off signal than the prior run's 'index near highs despite narrow breadth' divergence story.
